problems.problem: The agent failed to explicitly list which documents are "Retrieved required evidence documents" and which are "Missing required evidence documents" in the `reasoning` field.

The agent relied on internal knowledge to confirm the scientific name of the American black bear instead of identifying the required document as missing, violating the instruction not to rely on internal knowledge to fill in factual gaps.
